format: DanceFlow Studio/Custom competitions, mid-event running-order changes
requirement: Allow controlled mid-event re-sequencing of unstarted floor heats only, in place on the live version, by one atomic RPC; never alter completed or running heats, their assignments, ballots, results or execution records; every accepted change appends an immutable revision (authorized actor, reason, timestamp, before/after order, snapshot, exact diff) and the original publication is preserved. Label it DanceFlow policy, never a body rule.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future apply_competition_running_order_change RPC plus an evidence-backed UPDATE path in _comp10d_guard_floor_heat. Today the order is frozen after publication and republishing is refused once any heat ran (COMPO1_RUN_IN_PROGRESS).
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Resolves O1 open decision 3 at the design level only, pending owner confirmation of the design; 'status carry-over' through a new version is rejected because new versions copy heats as new rows.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
